topic: x86-64 Integer Arithmetic and Multiplication/Division Instructions
explanation: This concept describes how the x86-64 architecture handles integer arithmetic, specifically focusing on multiplication and division operations at the assembly level. Understanding these instructions is crucial for systems programming because they directly impact performance and efficient memory usage, especially when dealing with large integers that exceed the native word size of the processor.
